name: Firefox Places
param_style: :named (mozStorage BindByName / Sqlite.sys.mjs); urlbar and bookmark SQL assembled from JS template strings
schema_source: CREATE_MOZ_* macros in toolkit/components/places/nsPlacesTables.h and CREATE_PLACES_IDX expansions in nsPlacesIndexes.h, reassembled; TEMP tables made ordinary; TEMP triggers omitted (they call app-registered functions)
data_scale: scale 1: 1000 hosts/origins, 40k places, 150k visits, ~6.2k bookmarks (120 folders, 40 tags, ~3k tag entries), 5k input-history rows, 300 open tabs, 3k favicon pages / 2k icons (~25 MB)
visibility_note: Places is the history/bookmarks store of every Firefox profile (hundreds of millions of installs); the urlbar runs these queries on each keystroke
interest_note: Origin autofill: CTE with four window functions partitioned by a computed host, a correlated subquery inside total() OVER, top-1 then url_hash IN probes; frecency-ordered suggestion scan with correlated bookmark/tag subqueries feeding a CASE predicate; recursive CTEs over the bookmark tree (incl. one driving an UPDATE) and redirect chains; NTILE threshold; GROUP BY/HAVING tag intersection; GC deletes with EXCEPT and NOT IN.
reach_note: every Firefox desktop profile (~150M+ monthly users); places.sqlite is hit on every keystroke in the address bar
